message: Every family has that one friend who panics at the first sign of a storm—mine is my neighbor, who thinks every thunderclap is a sign of impending doom. If you've got someone like that in your life (or maybe it's you), this guide is a handy resource to help sort through the noise. It’s all about staying informed and calm, so we can enjoy a cozy evening inside instead of worrying. What’s your go-to storm snack?
